evidence: bme-model Python 3.11 compileall passed for src and scripts
full pytest suite passed with 116 tests after the cross-fit and clean-worktree changes
Ruff passed after the review changes
DTP fusion CUDA smoke passed on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 Laptop GPU with 32776192 peak allocated bytes
quality_report.json records 1112 attachments, 39 subjects, 1078 preprocessed attachments, 34 quarantined attachments, and 161 evaluable events
quality expectations, subject split fingerprints, source hashes, and schema/multisection counts are enforced before training
39-versus-40 subject identity and official partial-event scoring remain external UNKNOWNs and are documented as limitations
each outer fold now trains three subject-disjoint DTP models, merges their held-out predictions into complete outer-training OOF, and averages their outer-test probabilities
each DTP checkpoint is selected by masked window AUPRC before fusion is tuned once on the combined cross-fit OOF
50 percent positive batch sampling requires explicit focal_positive_alpha 0.5 and records the actual alpha in metadata
fusion selection records the best beta-only comparator and requires incremental DTP F1 with no different-hand recall or FP-per-hour degradation
outer-fold diagnostics and zero recall no longer stop later folds; five-fold promotion is the only final decision
subject-level outer folds, all three inner partitions, per-model seeds, data/config hashes, cross-fit checkpoint hashes, artifact hashes, and resume signatures are recorded or checked
run manifest schema 2 now records experiment name and fold and the comparator rejects dirty, mixed-commit, mixed-config, mutated-artifact, mutated-input, or duplicate-subject evidence
formal training remains blocked until the current dirty working tree is reviewed, committed, and synchronized
frozen baseline has complete five-fold local metrics with micro F1 0.4701
baseline_dyadic has only fold 0 and F1 0.4000 versus baseline fold 0 F1 0.4783
baseline_boundary has no held-out test metrics because postprocessing search hit boundaries
no real baseline_dtp_fusion experiment output exists, so the new candidate has no empirical improvement evidence

findings.title: DTP final model does not use the full outer-training cohort
Balanced sampling and focal alpha double-compensate the positive class
Fusion gate does not prove incremental DTP value over beta-only calibration
Epoch and fusion pair selection reuse one small validation partition
Fold 0 held-out gate conditionally selects the reported five-fold candidate
Baseline OOF and final-model probability calibration may differ
Training validation and test DataLoaders could retain 24 Windows workers
